items.description: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge agents for blind evaluation, validates improvements through test prompts with auto-break on diminishing returns, and generates visual result cards. Use when user mentions \"优化skill\", \"skill评分\", \"自动优化\", \"auto optimize\", \"skill质量检查\", \"达尔文\", \"darwin\", \"帮我改改skill\", \"skill怎么样\", \"提升skill质量\", \"skill review\", \"skill打分\".
